The barber

Over 21 years behind the chair

Established in 1998, Wass’ Barbers is built on more than 21 years of experience, over ten of them here in New Zealand.

The mobile barbershop came from a simple idea: keep overheads low, so prices stay competitive and there is no need to book. You turn up, and you get cut.
